name: animated-hamburger-menu
title: Animated Hamburger Menu
description: Animated Hamburger Menu is a free React menu button with eight hamburger icon animations, squeeze, pivot, arrow, stagger, duo, split, wipe and loop, that turn three bars into a close X or a back arrow using only CSS transitions, with aria-expanded state, a hover hint, size, thickness and duration props, and reduced motion support.
author: Wensity <hey@wensity.com>
